notes: MONO-BLACK, built pool-only from share/ (764 owned cards). Every maindeck card is owned. Nothing in the 100 is a purchase.
PRIMARY KILL (✓ rules-verified, stack 001, checker pass, 3 iterations): Blowfly Infestation + Nest of Scarabs is an unbounded loop. 38 completed iterations take four opponents from 40 to 0.

BASTION OF REMEMBRANCE IS A HARD REQUIREMENT, NOT A FLEX SLOT. Stack 001 proved the build requirement is a body count. Blowfly's target locks when its trigger is put on the stack (CR 115.1d), at which moment state-based actions have already killed the counter-bearing token (CR 117.5) and Nest's replacement Insect does not yet exist. Whatever creature is on the battlefield at that instant is what Blowfly eats. A CREATURE drain (Zulaport Cutthroat) therefore needs three creatures on board at loop start — the drain, the counter-bearer, and one spare — or it is forcibly eaten on iteration one and the drain stops at 3 per opponent, ending them at 37 with no finite number of iterations reaching zero. Bastion is an Enchantment, so Blowfly can never target it, AND its enters-the-battlefield trigger supplies the 1/1 Human Soldier that absorbs the ignition counter. It satisfies both halves alone.

Zulaport Cutthroat and Blood Artist are kept as redundancy, not as the primary drain. Both strategy agents originally named Zulaport as the pod kill on correct arithmetic (it drains EACH opponent) and were wrong about the board.

SECOND KILL, one purchase away: Exquisite Blood (PURCHASE) pairs with the already-owned, otherwise-idle Enduring Tenacity for a two-card infinite. Enduring Tenacity is pinned above for that reason. UNVERIFIED — no resolve-stack run yet.

The 35 pins exist because the deterministic scorer weights similarity 0.30 and synergy 0.22 against EDHREC 0.10, so it optimises for on-theme rather than powerful. Left to itself on the previous build it passed over Necropotence, Vampiric Tutor and Lightning Greaves in favour of bulk. The pins are the correction.
